_comment: Stand-ins for npx and the ElevenLabs CLI (evals/onboarding/bin) are on PATH. Each `onboard` step prints the real CLI's reply (next, run, say, details, rules) and decides from the workspace the way the real one does; a case's `env` can script a step's reply (a list is one reply per call). Every call is appended to outputs/elevenlabs-calls.txt with the folder it ran in, then `  -> <next>` for its reply. `<file> [never] shows <text> [after <text>]` is checked literally, in order; the stand-in's lines start with `elevenlabs onboard`, npx's with `npx`.

evals.prompt: Add text to speech to my app: it's a Next.js notes app, and it should read notes aloud. I don't have an ElevenLabs account yet.
evals.expected_output: Runs onboard init in the app and signs in, writes the code with the SDK, runs check until it offers the test, and asks before any test request
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard connect after elevenlabs onboard init
elevenlabs-calls.txt shows -> offer_test after elevenlabs onboard connect
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard test

evals.prompt: Set me up with ElevenLabs in this project.
evals.expected_output: Runs onboard init and signs in, then asks what the user wants to build before writing any code (nothing in the conversation or the empty project says)
expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt shows elevenlabs onboard connect after elevenlabs onboard init
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard check

evals.prompt: I'm on an SSH box. Add speech to text to this repo with ElevenLabs.
evals.expected_output: Relays the CLI's manual key steps to the user and waits; does not sign in

env.ONBOARD_INIT_JSON:
{"next": "ask_user", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard check --env-file .env.local", "say": "A browser can't reach this machine (an SSH session, a container or a cloud environment), so the approval page can't hand a key to it. Please add a key by hand:
1. Create a key at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys.
2. Paste it after ELEVENLABS_API_KEY= in .env.local, or set ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in this environment's secrets.
3. Never paste it into this chat. Tell me when it's done.", "rules": ["Never open, print or cat the env file; run `onboard check` to verify it.", "Never ask for an API key in chat, and never accept one pasted there.", "Never put the key in code; the SDK reads ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.", "Never run git clean or delete untracked files.", "Don't run the app or make your own API calls to try the key unless the user says yes. Once the code is written, run `onboard check` before you finish: it verifies the key and the code."], "details": {"env_file": ".env.local"}}
env.ONBOARD_CHECK_JSON: {"next": "ask_user", "run": "npx -y @elevenlabs/cli@latest onboard check --env-file .env.local", "say": "ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in .env.local is still empty. Paste the key after the = (never into this chat), and tell me when it's done."}

expectations: elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard connect
elevenlabs-calls.txt never shows elevenlabs onboard check

evals.prompt: I'm building a browser game and want ElevenLabs sound effects in it: explosions and UI clicks. I'll approve in the browser, it might take me a minute.
evals.expected_output: Keeps running onboard connect --wait while the approval is open, then continues to check
